name: ORCHESTRATION ENGINE, STATE MACHINE, RETRY AND RECOVERY
features: Explicit 15-state TaskStateMachine with strict transition validation
RetryPolicy with exponential backoff and error classification checking
TaskScheduler bounded concurrency slots, priority queue, and project lock
CancellationManager for graceful and immediate token cancellation
RecoveryManager crash reconciliation protecting against automatic destructive tool re-execution
DurableExecutionFacts storage and derived UI status computation
